entities.summary: Marta de Souza Sobral is a former Brazilian female basketball player. Sobral, while a member of the Brazil women's national basketball team, participated in three Summer Olympics, and won a medal in two of them. She is the sister of fellow Brazilian basketball Olympian Leila Sobral.
